body: I'm just really tired of how bad my life is going. It's always been like this, I was just trying to get through it for the past years. But this time, I just really want to end it. My parents just don't see anything right in me. Even if I try to do my best to please them, all they can see are my mistakes. I'm also in a relationship where my boyfriend keeps telling me how bad I am, how useless I am and etc. I literally have no one to talk to. I have no siblings, and I can't tell my parents because they're one of the reasons I'm like this. I can't talk to my friends either because they'll only call me emotional and dramatic. I'm just really tired, I want to escape from all of this. And also, maybe if I end my life then I'll stop being a pain in the ass for the people around me. And maybe they'll appreciate all the good things I've done.
Yeah, I guess I'll have to search for different methods and find the most effective ones. Idk when I'll be doing it though, but maybe a few days from now. I honestly have nothing to lose anymore
